audience: A developer at a restaurant group connecting their point-of-sale system to Rota
task: One documentation page: authenticate and pull this week's published rota.
facts: Auth: a bearer token from Settings, API, scoped read:rota
GET /rotas?week=2026-W45 returns shifts with staff_id, role, start, end (ISO 8601, site time zone)
Rate limit: 60 requests a minute per token; 429 with Retry-After
mustInclude: A complete curl example and its response
outOfScope: Writing rotas through the API (not supported)
